summary: Practise underground incident assessment, rescue command and team accountability. Explore the mine rescue course and its practical learning outcomes.
lede: Mine rescue training prepares underground response personnel to assess incidents and coordinate rescue actions using mine plans, monitoring information and documented roles. Mine rescue team members, underground supervisors and emergency coordinators practise interpreting gas and ventilation information, assigning command and team roles, maintaining accountability, and planning deployments. Tabletop scenarios produce hazard assessments, decision logs and improvement actions; advanced equipment procedures and site-specific protocols receive introductory treatment and need workplace validation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mine personnel who coordinate or support underground emergency response and need to make role-based decisions from mine plans, monitoring information and team accountability records.
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with underground mine operations, site alarm procedures and basic emergency arrangements. Coding or programming is not required.
